collection.description: A child who is nearly fourteen goes to bed early, sure they will wake up feeling completely different.

setup.name: The moment
setup.text: (name1) is nearly fourteen, and (he/she) has decided that tomorrow, when (he/she) wakes up, (he/she) will feel completely different: older, cleverer, and probably taller. (He/She) goes to bed early, so it will happen faster. In the morning, (he/she) lies very still with (his/her) eyes closed, checking. (He/She) feels... the same. Exactly the same. (His/Her) feet still don't reach the end of the mat. (He/She) is a bit disappointed. Then (he/she) gets up, and it's a lovely morning, and someone has made fruit for breakfast, and (he/she) forgets to be disappointed. Maybe growing up happens slowly, (he/she) thinks, a little bit at a time, while you're busy doing other things.
